name: github-copilot-browser
postInstallMessage: Load the matching GitHub Copilot extension, then start a new session. Browser registration activates automatically at session start, and Browser guidance loads automatically when needed. Use `/github-copilot-browser:activate` to activate this installation immediately or repair setup, `/github-copilot-browser:doctor` for diagnostics, and `/github-copilot-browser:deactivate` before uninstalling or replacing this installation.
